# restate_service_handler (Data Source)

One handler of a discovered service.

Everything here comes from discovery: the Admin API has no handler modification endpoint, so a handler cannot be configured through Terraform. Use it to reference a handler in a `restate_subscription` sink and be sure it exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Confirm a handler exists before referencing it as a subscription sink, so a typo fails the plan
# rather than the apply.

data "restate_service_handler" "handle_order" {
  service = "OrderService"
  name    = "handleOrder"
}

output "handler_type" {
  value = data.restate_service_handler.handle_order.type
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Handler name.
- `service` (String) Service the handler belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `abort_timeout` (String) Handler-level abort timeout, when it overrides the service's.
- `documentation` (String) Documentation the SDK reported for this handler.
- `idempotency_retention` (String) Handler-level idempotency retention, when it overrides the service's.
- `inactivity_timeout` (String) Handler-level inactivity timeout, when it overrides the service's.
- `input_description` (String) Human-readable description of the accepted request content types.
- `journal_retention` (String) Handler-level journal retention, when it overrides the service's.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Handler metadata reported by discovery.
- `output_description` (String) Human-readable description of the response content types.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the handler is reachable through ingress. Null when the API reports nothing.
- `type` (String) Handler concurrency model: `Exclusive`, `Shared`, or `Workflow`. Empty when the API reports none.
